decisions.reason: The profile storage robot remains a complementary element of automated pallet circulation, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration, the firm has little reason to withdraw it.
The automatic shuttering robot is core to the firm's automation strategy and likely absorbed the functions of the withdrawn A and B robots, so it stays.
This multi-model machine line was only launched in 2024 and builds on established offerings, so the firm's slack allows it to carry the line while results are still uncertain.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain and supports digital, future-ready plant offerings and service revenue, so there is no reason to drop it.
